messages:
oliver: FYI saw a puzzler on the latency page after yesterday's routing tweak: p99 dropped ~140ms but p95 increased ~90ms. Dashboard only shows merged percentiles so it's confusing. anyone looked?

priya: i think this is the mixed-route effect — fallback moved some midtail mass. merged tdigest can make p99 look better while p95 degrades. we need per-route numbers.

devon: quick diagnostic: group by route+token_bucket and compare exact vs tdigest for routes with >500 samples. should show if it's a merge artifact.

telemetry-bot: run started by priya: per-route quantiles (/v1/complete) 30m window. ETA ~20s.

telemetry-bot: results: main p50 72ms p95 185ms p99 910ms cnt 34,200; fallback p50 128ms p95 340ms p99 430ms cnt 4,100; merged tdigest p95 225ms merged sampled exact p95 190ms. fallback_fraction ~10%.

janet (console): UX implications: people read endpoint p95 and assume one distribution. propose small changes: (1) add a "routes:N" badge on the sparkline; (2) expand hover to show per-route p50/p95/p99 + counts; (3) show an "approx" pill when tdigest is used; (4) auto-open per-route view when bimodal_flag=true or fallback_fraction>5%.

oliver: +1. also for rollouts change default comparator to per-route p95 (or show merged+per-route side-by-side). PMs keep approving when merged p99 looks fine but midtail regresses.

priya: infra asks: we should emit a bimodal_flag at ingestion (diptest or gmm separation) so UI can auto-surface mixed-mode warning. i can add a job to compute diptest on 15m windows.

sre-oncall: operational note: header X-Route-Used exists but some edge rewrites drop it. SRE will trace mobile flow and fix gateway mapping; otherwise backfills can't attribute routes.

devon: short-term backend change: mark endpoints with bimodal_flag and show a yellow banner: "Mixed routing detected (Y% fallback). View per-route breakdown." Longer term: add a lightweight fixed-bucket histogram per-endpoint as a hybrid aggregator — more stable quantiles than tdigest under multimodal loads.

janet (console): UI will support a "compute exact" button that requests prefer_exact_quantiles=true for the current window (costly). default remains merged tdigest for cheap fast view. when bimodal_flag=true, console will suggest exact computation.

telemetry-bot: note: exact queries require fetching raw samples and increase cost ~3-5x.

oliver: action items: priya -> add diptest job + post threshold; janet -> spec routes badge, hover, approx pill, compute-exact flow; devon -> prototype histogram aggregator; sre-oncall -> verify X-Route-Used preservation and post results. also update rollout runbook: "If fallback_fraction>3% or bimodal_flag=true, check per-route p50/p95 before approving."

priya: posted initial diptest query snippet to ticket and suggested threshold dip>0.3. will run hourly and emit flag.

janet (console): tiny UX quibble: when showing per-route numbers include counts inline ("p95 340ms (4.1k)") and a tiny legend for route colors. PMs want counts next to numbers.

devon: agree. also add a short auto-alert: if fallback_fraction spikes >8% in 10m page oncall. that should catch bad weight flips quickly.

oliver: thanks team. once the badge+tooltip is live it should reduce confusion. tagging @product and @sre for visibility. :thumbsup:
